answer:
In Ollama version 0.32.10 and later, models that do not set their own `repeat_penalty` now default to 1.0, which effectively means the repeat penalty is turned off. This change was made to match other engines and improve the speed of speculative decoding.

This information is provided in the context from "[1] ollama/v0.32.10.md":

- "Models that don't set a `repeat_penalty` now default to 1.0 (off) instead of 1.1, matching other engines and speeding up speculative decoding; set a per-model parameter if an older model repeats itself."

[1] ollama/v0.32.10.md (lines 1-9) [URL: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.32.10]
